name: volt-hello
description: An example Volt extension: a tool agents can call to remember facts, and a turn counter.

voltTools.name: hello_remember
voltTools.title: Remembered with Hello
voltTools.description: Remember a fact for every later Volt chat. Use it when the user says to remember something.

fact.description: The fact, in one or two sentences.

optional.reason: Counts your chats' turns and reads how many notes Volt keeps.
hello_remember saves the facts you ask it to keep.
